_comment: Keys are the anchor IDs (ANCHOR_ID in the anchor sketch, ANCHORS[] in uwb_tag). Positions in metres on the floor plan: measure them with a tape. bias_m is subtracted from every range of that anchor (antenna delay error): measured - true distance at a known spot. Optional per-anchor scale (default 1): the tag computes d = scale * d_measured - bias_m. iir_alpha: the tag's IIR coefficient (0..1, 1 = no filtering). map_size_m: side of the square map view in metres, centred on the anchors (remove it to fit the anchors).
